evals.prompt: Upscale a folder of 2D illustration PNGs by 2x with level 2 noise reduction using Vulkan GPU acceleration.
evals.expected_outcome: Runs preflight, verifies waifu2x command flags (-s 2 -n 2 -m models-cunet), and executes batch upscale.
assertions: Configures 2x scale and noise reduction flags

evals.prompt: Generate a photorealistic image from prompt using Flux.1 Schnell diffusion model.
evals.expected_outcome: Routes out to image instead of waifu2x-vulkan.
assertions: Routes generative diffusion synthesis to image
